def.name: identityVerification
def.dd: matching a live capture of the candidate against the photograph enrolled at registration, to confirm that the person sitting the examination is the person registered for it

arg.Evidence: Product scope statement: not covered by Annex I harmonisation legislation
Intended purpose statement: remote biometric verification of candidates (Annex III, point 1(a))
Function specification: identity is confirmed before the examination begins; no input to admission, grading or monitoring

dd.Evidence: Risk management file: false accept and false reject analysis for identity verification (Art. 9)
Enrolment data governance and demographic bias audit of the matcher (Art. 10)
Annex IV technical documentation, Identity Verification (Art. 11)
Verification decision log specification and retention test report (Art. 12)
Instructions for use for examination boards (Art. 13)
Proctor review procedure for every rejected verification (Art. 14)
Matcher accuracy and presentation attack detection benchmark (Art. 15)
ISO 9001-aligned quality management system certificate (Art. 17)
Notified body conformity assessment certificate, Annex III point 1 (Art. 43)
CE marking affixation record (Art. 48)
EU declaration of conformity and EU database registration (Art. 49)

def.name: behaviourMonitoring
def.dd: detecting prohibited behaviour during a remote examination from the candidate video and audio stream, including gaze direction, head pose and the presence of additional people

arg.Evidence: Product scope statement: not covered by Annex I harmonisation legislation
Data flow specification: gaze and head pose are derived from biometric data of the candidate (Annex III, point 1)
Intended purpose statement: monitoring and detecting prohibited behaviour of students during tests (Annex III, point 3(d))

dd.Evidence: Risk management file: false accusation and disparate impact analysis for behaviour monitoring (Art. 9)
Training data governance audit, including disability and environment coverage (Art. 10)
Annex IV technical documentation, Examination Behaviour Monitoring (Art. 11)
Flagged-incident log specification and retention test report (Art. 12)
Instructions for use, including the limits of automated flagging (Art. 13)
Human proctor adjudication procedure: no flag results in a sanction without review (Art. 14)
Detection accuracy benchmark across lighting, device and assistive technology conditions (Art. 15)
ISO 9001-aligned quality management system certificate (Art. 17)
Notified body conformity assessment certificate, Annex III points 1 and 3 (Art. 43)
CE marking affixation record (Art. 48)
EU declaration of conformity and EU database registration (Art. 49)
Annex IV technical documentation section 1(b) and independent architecture review AR-2026-014, identifying every AI component in the deployed build
